title: Loop State
description: Tracks the orchestration state of a governed Ralph Loop (autonomous iterative development cycle). Reconciled to match the operational contract in schemas/loop-state.schema.json, which is what demerzel_kit enforces at write time (demerzel_kit.py SCHEMA_DIR -> schemas/); both files now carry the same TOP-LEVEL required set. This file remains MORE PERMISSIVE than the enforced copy one level down: schemas/ requires `outcome` in iterations.items and sets additionalProperties:false at both levels; this file does neither. The richer auditability fields (worker, reviewer, convergence, outcome, current_iteration) are REMOVED ENTIRELY, not retained as optional: no loop instance has ever carried them and no script reads them, so they were aspirational rather than dropped guarantees. Reintroducing them requires changing schemas/loop-state.schema.json first, because that copy sets additionalProperties:false and would reject them. Issue #834 tracks enriching the emitter; the duplication between this file and schemas/loop-state.schema.json is tracked separately and should be collapsed to one source of truth.

goal.description: What the loop is trying to accomplish

repo.description: Which repo the loop operates in (e.g., demerzel, ix, tars, ga)

risk.description: Risk classification determined before the loop starts

action.description: What the worker did in this iteration

outcome.description: Result of the iteration (e.g., progress, shipped, blocked, halted)

governance_decision.description: Governance gate decision for this iteration, if any

belief_state.description: Tetravalent belief state for the iteration outcome (optional)

stall_count.description: Count of consecutive iterations without measurable progress

max_iterations.description: Hard cap on iterations (default 10, absolute max 25)

authorization_artifact.description: Reference to the artifact that authorized the loop (e.g., github_issue:#381)
